verifications.check_code:
from itertools import permutations
sent=[({'mountain','stand','tall'},['33','66','44']),({'rocky','is','tall'},['44','55','11']),({'rocky','is','mountain'},['33','55','11'])]
words=['mountain','stand','tall','rocky','is']
codes=['11','33','44','55','66']
sols=[]
for p in permutations(codes):
    m=dict(zip(words,p))
    if all(sorted(m[w] for w in ws)==sorted(c) for ws,c in sent): sols.append(m)
assert len({m['stand'] for m in sols})==1
r=sols[0]['stand']
opts={'A':'33','B':'11','C':'44','D':'66'}
assert opts['D']==r
assert all(opts[k]!=r for k in 'ABC')

s=['KES','MIQ','PMN','TQJ','YUE']
for i in range(4):
    assert sh(s[i][0],i+2)==s[i+1][0] and sh(s[i][1],4)==s[i+1][1] and sh(s[i][2],-(i+2))==s[i+1][2]

def sh(c,n): return chr((ord(c)-65+n)%26+65)
seq=['KES']
cur=list('KES')
for i in range(5):
    cur=[sh(cur[0],2+i),sh(cur[1],4),sh(cur[2],-(2+i))]
    seq.append(''.join(cur))
assert seq[:5]==['KES','MIQ','PMN','TQJ','YUE']
r=seq[5]
opts={'A':'EYY','B':'EXY','C':'EXZ','D':'FYX'}
assert opts['A']==r
assert all(opts[k]!=r for k in 'BCD')
